requirement: Students analyze words with affixes by identifying and attaching common prefixes and suffixes to base words. Focus: Decoding words using knowledge of prefixes (un-, re-, pre-) and suffixes (-ed, -ing, -ly). Examples: unhappy, rewrite, preview, jumped, playing, quickly, redo, dislike, walker, helpful. Constraints: Highlight the base word and affix in different colors in the word-builder.
